Microsoft ne karib 60,000 karmachariyon ko Voluntary Exit Package ki peshkash ki hai, jismen bharat, amerika, kanada aur briten ki kuchh timen shamil hain. AI men barhte nivesh ke bich kanpni ke is kadam ne tek sektar men Jobs par AI ke asar ko lekar naee chinta barha di hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
